cohort: All 14 entries labeled REG in the DIMACS COLOR catalog, without size or difficulty exclusions
objective: Maximum cardinality set of pairwise noninterfering register-allocation vertices. Use the original graph, retain isolated vertices, collapse repeated undirected edges.
schedule: Fixed ER_small feasible exchange search for all instances, without RB-specific clique branching. Identical exchange settings for learned and degree.
input: Resident CPU edge list for every method
endpoints: largest host-materialized feasible set at 200 ms (zero on miss)
aggregation: Each graph has three seeds. Take the arithmetic mean over graph-seed pairs. For contrasts average within each graph before calculating the cross-graph mean. The 14 instances represent four source programs.
